text.title: Technical SEO for AI Worked Examples
text.summary: Filled artefacts for the rules in 01-core-rules.xml. llms.txt format and robots.txt configuration for AI crawlers (GPTBot, Claude-Web, PerplexityBot) — including citation format preferences, important page declarations, and URL structure requirements for AI parsing. Article schema with author credentials, Organization schema, and FAQSchema — the structured data types that signal authority to AI systems and enable accurate entity recognition and citation in AI-generated responses.

example.note: llms.txt with crawler guidance and citation format.
example.code:
# llms.txt - AI crawler guidance User-agent: * Allow: /content/ Disallow: /admin/ Disallow: /premium/
# Preferred citation format Citation-style: [Title](URL) - Author
# Key pages for entity understanding Important: /about Important: /methodology Important: /research
